scope: Tiny deterministic local contracts; runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Validate source identity explicitly
cases.input_contract: Trim an ID token and return Right for nonempty text. Return Left(missing_id) for null, empty or whitespace-only tokens. Do not invent an identifier.
cases.expected: " a1 " gives Right("a1");null,"" and"  " each give Left("missing_id").
cases.verification: Assert one normalized identity and all three missing representations without throwing.

cases.title: Reject unsupported domain states
cases.input_contract: Accept only trimmed lowercase paid or void. Return Left(unknown_status) for all other supplied values, including uppercase PAID and null. Do not silently case-fold unless the source contract explicitly permits it.
cases.expected: " paid " and"void" return Right("paid") and Right("void");"mystery","PAID" and null are rejected.
cases.verification: Assert both valid states and three unsupported forms; confirm that whitespace normalization is separate from case normalization.

cases.title: Preserve exact bounded cents
cases.input_contract: Accept trimmed ASCII digits representing 0 through 1000000 as a Long. Return Left(invalid_amount) for null, blank, signed, decimal, overflowing or out-of-domain text.
cases.expected: "0" and"100" become Right(0L), Right(100L);"bad","-1","1.5","1000001" and a huge integer token are rejected.
cases.verification: Assert zero separately from rejection, and test both lexical failure and numeric range failure.

cases.title: Compose fields with declared error precedence
cases.input_contract: Require exactly three pipe-separated fields and compose ID, status, amount validation in that order using a for comprehension. Return Left(malformed_record) for null or wrong field count. Preserve empty trailing fields for validation.
cases.expected: a1|paid|100 becomes Right(Record(a1, paid,100));a2|paid| becomes invalid_amount;an empty-ID malformed-status record reports missing_id first;two fields report malformed_record.
cases.verification: Assert a valid record, trailing-empty rejection, first-error precedence and field-count failure.

cases.title: Retain a complete rejection ledger
cases.input_contract: Parse every input line and return accepted records plus rejected(position, raw, reason) tuples. Position is the zero-based occurrence index; preserve encounter order in both outputs and never discard a Left.
cases.expected: The six-line fixture has three accepted records and rejections at positions 3,4,5 with missing_id, invalid_amount, unknown_status. Accepted plus rejected equals six.
cases.verification: Assert accepted IDs[a1, a2, a3], the exact rejected positions/reasons and count conservation.

cases.title: Separate valid records from eligible revenue
cases.input_contract: From already accepted records, return paid-event count and checked paid cents total. Retain an observed zero paid event in the count and exclude valid void records only at this business-report stage.
cases.expected: The three accepted records yield paid count 2, total 100. A void record with malformed amount must have been rejected by parseRecord before this function can run.
cases.verification: Assert the paid metrics and show that a4|void|bad produces Left(invalid_amount), not a silently skipped valid void.
